segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמֵּיחַם שֶׁפִּינָּהוּ לֹא יִתֵּן לְתוֹכוֹ צוֹנֵן בִּשְׁבִיל שֶׁיֵּחַמּוּ. אֲבָל נוֹתֵן הוּא לְתוֹכוֹ אוֹ לְתוֹךְ הַכּוֹס כְּדֵי לְהַפְשִׁירָן.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» The Sages added to the laws of leaving food on a source of heat and cooking food on Shabbat: «An urn that was emptied» of its hot water on Shabbat, «one may not place cold water into it so that» the cold water «will be heated. However, one may place» cold water «into» an urn «or into a cup» that were emptied of their hot water «in order to warm it» but not in order to heat it.

moves.cueHe: המיחם שפינהו לא יתן לתוכו צונן
moves.summary: Not to put cold water in to heat it
But may put it in to warm it

positions.claim: not to heat cold water in an emptied urn, but one may add it to warm it slightly
